issue_context.title: More updates to PyO3 0.21 Bound<> APIs

review_comments: How does that work? Does python need to convert to a `pybytes` first. And if so, isn't it easier to just accept `String` here?

Looking at https://github.com/PyO3/pyo3/blob/5d2f5b5702319150d41258de77f589119134ee74/src/pybacked.rs#L56

* Currently it creates PyBytes, yes.
* Once 3.10 is minimum version, it will switch to more efficient version.

So a `String` would maybe be slightly more efficient, but would require going back and switching to more efficient `PyBackedStr` once 3.10 is minimal version.

**Edited** since I said some wrong things first pass.
Most of these usages don't seem like performance hot path?
